title: Kinoshita Circus Arena Construction, 1950s Japan B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot showing the extensive bamboo and timber scaffolding erected for a Kinoshita Circus showground in mid-century Japan. The front entrance displays illustrated banners featuring a performing sea lion and elephant, with Japanese signage announcing an extension of the performance run due to daily packed audiences. A passing figure and child are partially visible in the bottom-left corner.
